messages:
Carlos (AE): Heads-up team — ZephyrBank sent an 88-question RFI + capability matrix. They want technical responses, security questionnaire, a 3-week POC SOW (with optional Private smoke), and a pricing band for Dedicated vs Private. Deadline next Mon EOD. Uploaded: /shared/zephyrbank/rfi/zephyr_rfi_v2.xlsx. Can we split?

Mina (SE): I can take the capability matrix and perf tables. Will triage the questions that need eng. Quick nuance: they included a row asking for "explainability / provenance" for generated answers — do we call out our redaction and trace metadata features?

Carlos (AE): Yes, they care about provenance. Call out token-level provenance (KV cache audit), structured metadata in responses, and optional request/response hashing for audit trails.

Ruth (Security): I27ll own the security questionnaire. Looks like 30 standard items + BYOK/HSM, PCI notes, and a new question on redaction policies for PII. I27ll draft standard answers and flag anything that needs Legal.

Ethan (Pricing): I27ll draft the pricing bands and POC commercial. Need Mina's QPS/token throughput table (100/500/1000 QPS embed-heavy vs gen-heavy) to size Dedicated pools and estimate burst costs.

Mina (SE): Quick back-of-envelope from their sample workload: embed-heavy (75% embeds @ ~300 tokens) and gen tails (25% @ ~900 tokens). Estimates: 100 QPS -> ~30k tks/s, 500 QPS -> ~150k tks/s, 1k QPS -> ~300k tks/s. Will add a small table to the matrix.

Mina (SE): Suggested capability cell for "provenance & redaction": "Provenance metadata and redaction hooks 15 Supported. Redwood can emit per-response provenance metadata (model variant, tokens used, KV-hash) and supports post-response redaction policies via the platform27s transformation layer. For Private deployments, customers can enforce guaranteed on-prem redaction before logs leave their environment."

Ruth (Security): Security draft samples: TLS1.2+ and TLS1.3 support, AES-256 at rest, role-based access, SOC2 Type II available under NDA, BYOK via AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault, HSM appliances supported on Private. For PII redaction: "Platform supports configured redaction policies and can integrate with customer DLP for inline scrubbing during ingestion." Flagging PCI attestation + export control Qs for Omar.

Omar (Legal): On it. If they ask for formal PCI attestation or vendor indemnities for third-party models, we should add a legal caveat: "PCI attestation and vendor indemnities require scoped engagement and may involve third-party vendor terms." I'll draft a short escalation paragraph for the submission.

Carlos (AE): They requested a sample POC SOW and a short SLA blurb for Dedicated burst. Mina, can you paste a concise SOW and SLA?

Mina (SE): POC SOW snippet: "- Week 0: provisioning & VPC peering (credentials, VPC setup, IAM)
- Week 1: ingest & baseline perf (embedding throughput, generation latency)
- Week 2: security verification, provenance tests, optional Private smoke (BYOK/HSM)
- Deliverables: perf report, runbook, incident playbook, recommendation for model/quantization profiles."

Mina (SE): SLA blurb: "Redwood Dedicated: 99.95% availability for reserved pools. Burst capacity is best-effort and subject to regional availability; automatic graceful fallback to compatible model variants or alternate region is available and can be disabled if customer pins routes."

Ethan (Pricing): Attachments to prepare: capability_matrix_zephyr.xlsx (Mina), security_answers_zephyr.docx (Ruth), poc_sow_zephyr.pdf (Ethan), pricing_ranges_zephyr.csv (Ethan), regression_eval_set.zip (they asked for sample evals). Upload folder?

Carlos (AE): Use /shared/zephyrbank/rfi/submission_v2/. I will compress and send after approvals.

drive-bot: Snapshot created: https://drive.internal/s/zephyrbank/rfi/submission_v2/ :white_check_mark:

Ruth (Security): A couple of inline sample answers I'm adding to the sheet: Q: "Who can access logs and metadata?" A: "For Private, logs and metadata remain in the customer environment. For Hosted/Dedicated, logs are tenant-scoped; access by Redwood engineers is limited to authorized personnel with audit trails and justified access. Customers may export logs to their own S3/GCS for custody."

Ethan (Pricing): Timeline: Mina by Thu 11am for matrix + perf table, Ruth Thu 3pm for security draft, Omar Thu 5pm for legal escalation language, I27ll have pricing + POC by Thu 6pm so Carlos can review Fri morning.

Omar (Legal): I'll add a short paragraph clarifying PCI and model-license indemnity caveats by Thu 5pm. Also confirm whether they want EU-only residency for EU customers; Carlos?

Carlos (AE): They did request EU residency for EU data. Note that in the security answers and in the POC (we can run Dedicated in eu-west for the trial).

Mina (SE): One more technical note for the matrix: quantization support (int8/int4) is available on Dedicated/Private with validated profiles; Hosted may offer select quantized builds per model after validation. I'll include that as a separate cell.

Carlos (AE): Thanks everyone. Please flag anything high-risk in the thread and @Omar for legal. I'll assemble the final bundle next Friday after reviews.
